sections.text: ARS-VLM: Visually Aligned Augmented Random Search for Vision-Language Models. ARS-VLM: Visually Aligned Augmented Random Search for Vision-Language Models First-order reinforcement learning, such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), is widely used to post-train Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for multimodal reasoning. However, it incurs heavy memory and system overhead from backpropagation, optimizer states, and a reference model.

VC-OPD: Learning to See What Matters via Visual Cue On-Policy Self-Distillation. VC-OPD: Learning to See What Matters via Visual Cue On-Policy Self-Distillation Visual On-Policy Distillation (OPD) commonly uses cropped or zoomed-in image regions as teacher-side privileged information to improve fine-grained perception in small Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs).

Rethinking Reasoning Effort Training in Large Language Models: On-Policy Distillation or Reinforcement Learning?. Rethinking Reasoning Effort Training in Large Language Models: On-Policy Distillation or Reinforcement Learning? Large language models have shown strong capabilities on complex tasks, yet how to control their reasoning effort remains a significant challenge for practical deployment. This paper provides a systematic investigation of reasoning-effort training, contrasting reinforcement learning (RL) with on-policy distillation (OPD).
